Chronic myeloid leukaemia data: longitudinal white blood cell count

Source: R/data.R
cml_wbc.Rd

Repeated white blood cell count (WBC) measurements for the 190 patients of cml, recorded every one to two months during the first stage of the Benelux Chronic Myeloid Leukaemia (CML) trial (Kluin-Nelemans et al. 1998). The data were originally distributed in the archived dynpred package (as wbc2).

Usage

data(cml_wbc)

Format

A data frame with 5600 rows, in long format (one row per measurement):

id

integer: patient identifier, shared with cml.

time

numeric: time in years from diagnosis at which the measurement was taken.

lwbc

numeric: WBC, transformed and centered as \({}^{10}\log(\mathrm{WBC}) - 0.95\).

Source

The archived dynpred package (GPL (>= 2)), companion to van Houwelingen & Putter (2012).

References

van Houwelingen HC, Putter H (2012). Dynamic Prediction in Clinical Survival Analysis. Chapman & Hall.

Kluin-Nelemans JC, Delannoy A, Louwagie A, le Cessie S, Hermans J, van der Burgh JF, Hagemeijer AM, van den Berghe H, Benelux CML Study Group (1998). Randomized study on hydroxyurea alone versus hydroxyurea combined with low-dose interferon-alpha 2b for chronic myeloid leukemia. Blood. 1998; 91: 2713-2721.

See also

cml for the companion static covariates and survival outcome.
